title: Foreground research has three automatic crash recoveries and preserves paid checkpoints on explicit resume
steps: Claim foreground research, save a paid Apify checkpoint and expire/reclaim three leases. Expire the fourth worker, poll own-site research and explicitly resume. Separately resume quota-paused research with twenty prior claims.
expect: After the initial claim and three takeovers, the next expiry pauses the place job and its requests with RESEARCH_RECOVERY_LIMIT and fences the old worker.
Explicit resume keeps the preparing snapshot, stage and paid-run IDs and resets the crash counter while lifetime attempts remain monotonic.
Quota resumes do not consume automatic recovery budget; own-site polling refuses to bypass the recovery limit.
fence: transactional expired-lease recovery counter distinct from lifetime claims, mirrored pause and own-site automatic restart refusal

cmd: --test-name-pattern=foreground crash recovery|quota resumes with many|own site polling surfaces
tests: foreground crash recovery stops after three takeovers and explicit resume keeps paid checkpoints
quota resumes with many prior attempts do not consume automatic crash recoveries
own site polling surfaces the crash recovery limit without automatically resuming it
